title: Preface to the English Edition
paragraphs: This volume holds Maṇḍala 5 · Sūktas 63–87 (with the Pariśiṣṭa) and Maṇḍala 6 · Sūktas 1–28 (Fourth Aṣṭaka, Adhyāyas 5 and 6 (to the end of the sixth adhyāya)). It runs to 53 sūktas on 844 printed pages of the Kannada edition.
{{Themes of the volume: the ṛṣis and families, the deities, the hymns the reader should not miss — two or three paragraphs, the editor's own.}}

The translation follows the Kannada edition of the Ṛgveda-saṃhitā with the Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya, edited and translated by Asthāna Mahāvidvān H. P. Venkata Rao (Śrī Jayacāmarājendra Vedaratna-mālā, 1953). What is reproduced from that edition, what is translated, and how the English was made are stated in the Note on this translation, which follows.
{{Why this English edition was made, and for whom: the editor's own reasons and the readers in mind.}}
{{Thanks: to the scholars, readers and families who made the work possible (wording to be decided; see REQUIREMENTS F8).}}
